title: Confidence-Aware Speed-over-Ground Estimation from Doppler Spectra via Reconstruction-Based Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.40253v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable speed-over-ground estimation from ground-facing Doppler spectra is essential for mobile platforms such as railway systems. Classical signal-processing approaches can provide accurate estimates under favorable conditions, but often degrade in challenging conditions. We propose confidence-aware speed-over-ground estimation trained on rail-domain data that estimates speed over ground and frame-level confidence from Doppler spectra with several novel contributions: First, we transfer the idea of exploiting a reconstruction task by an autoencoder for performance estimation from previous work to Doppler RaDAR. Second, we append a speed-over-ground estimation head operating on the autoencoder's latent space features. Third, we omit the reconstruction decoder during inference but add a low-cost dedicated confidence head for frame-wise error-bound estimation. translated_title: 基于重构式表征学习的置信度感知多普勒谱对地速度估计
translated_abstract: 从朝向地面的多普勒谱中进行可靠的对地速度估计，对于铁路系统等移动平台至关重要。经典信号处理方法在良好条件下能够提供准确的估计，但在具有挑战性的条件下性能往往下降。我们提出了在铁路领域数据上训练的置信度感知对地速度估计方法，可从多普勒谱中同时估计对地速度和帧级置信度，并包含以下几项创新贡献：首先，我们将先前工作中利用自编码器重构任务进行性能评估的思想迁移到多普勒雷达领域。其次，我们在自编码器的潜空间特征上附加了一个对地速度估计头。第三，我们在推理阶段省略了重构解码器，而是增加了一个低成本的专用置信度头，用于帧级误差界限估计。第四，我们揭示了噪声增强训练如何能够提供高（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于自编码器重构式表征学习的置信度感知方法，从多普勒谱中同时估计对地速度与帧级置信度，推理时省略解码器并采用专用置信度头进行误差界限估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a confidence-aware speed-over-ground estimation method based on reconstruction-based representation learning with an autoencoder, which jointly estimates speed and frame-level confidence from Doppler spectra while omitting the decoder at inference and adding a low-cost dedicated confidence head.
